plan.output: A reviewable weekly training streak and points summary from manually supplied session entries.
plan.trigger: A person enters or pastes a new training session.
steps: Validate each entry has a date and activity label.
Apply the proposed points rule to the supplied session.
Update a streak count using the dates in the test log.
Produce a weekly summary and flag gaps for review.
Ask a coach or test user to inspect whether the rules are useful.
plan.acceptanceCheck: On a fixed fictional log, compare every awarded point and streak count with a hand-calculated expected summary.
plan.humanBoundary: The user supplies and corrects all session records; a person chooses the scoring rule and reviews whether it encourages safe training. No workout advice is produced.

plan.output: A dated Markdown research-session record that a person can reopen and export.
plan.trigger: A researcher starts a session or asks to resume a saved one.
steps: Collect the title, notes and next-step note from the operator.
Format them into a dated Markdown record.
Save the record under a manually chosen session label.
Reopen the selected record and display its notes and next step.
Export the record for a person to inspect and share.
plan.acceptanceCheck: Save a fictional session, reopen it by its label, and verify the exported text contains all supplied notes and the next-step field.
plan.humanBoundary: The researcher supplies, names and checks the notes; this test does not crawl sources, establish factual accuracy, or prove shared editing.

plan.output: A short review memo listing possible assumptions and alternative questions from supplied conversation text.
plan.trigger: A facilitator pastes a conversation excerpt and its stated goal.
steps: Check that the supplied text and goal are present.
Draft possible assumptions as questions, not conclusions.
Suggest small alternative questions tied to exact supplied passages.
Mark suggestions that lack a clear text basis.
Return the memo for a facilitator to review or discard.
plan.acceptanceCheck: On fictional transcripts with a hand-written answer key, verify each suggested question points to a supplied passage and unsupported suggestions are marked.
plan.humanBoundary: A facilitator supplies the excerpt and goal, reviews every interpretation, and decides what to ask; the tool must not judge participants or infer personal traits.
